author: Bellular News
description:
SEGA replaced Shogun 2 with a $40 Complete Edition so bad it was pulled from Steam two days later. Broken art, new bugs and lost mod support are only part of the story. Space Marine’s troubled re-release reveals a familiar playbook, and this time SEGA tried to leave players with no other option.
